narrative.overview: The app icon is a board: a dark plum header strip over a lavender panel of coloured pills, with one red check. The site is that board at full scale, with tasks as rows that start with the app's own hollow priority rings and the real screenshots as the main pictures.
keyCharacteristics: Plum ground, lavender boards, strips hanging from the top edge.
Hollow rings in priority colours lead every task row; the red check is the one mark of done.
One project colour per pill, flat, never tinted.
One calm card (the offer) on an occupied board.

rules.name: The One Calm Card Rule
rules.body: Each board has at most one white offer card; everything else on it is a task row.

rules.name: The Flat Pill Rule
rules.body: Pill and ring colours are flat and unmixed: no tints, gradients or opacity washes of them.

dos: Do start every task row with a hollow ring in a priority or pill colour.
Do put real app screenshots on board panels, at their real aspect.
Do label sample tasks as sample data near the board.
Do keep store links as text buttons (no badge images) and every asset self-hosted.
donts: Don't add device mockups, gradient heroes or rows of equal feature cards.
Don't put a label or eyebrow above a heading; the strip names the panel instead.
Don't use any colour for decoration that is not from the icon or the app's rings.
Don't show a Review screen or name a competing app.
